about.en: BOBO is a community memecoin on Solana themed on Bobo the Bear, the bear-market character from 4chan's /biz/ board drawn by meme artist Rekt Tekashi. It is the SPL token with mint 4nV5gNwwP68zUDat26ySChREqVaQaLudfJBkSgEzpump, launched through pump.fun with a supply of about one billion and no protocol or issuer behind it. It is unrelated to the older Ethereum BOBO memecoins (0x5888641e3e6cBeA6D84Ba81EDb217bD691d3bE38 and 0xB90B2A35C65dBC466b04240097Ca756ad2005295) and to the Solana Bobo the Bear token at Bobo54AXWLGQWqCK6EZdrBQz4bKJXeBE9ExD1HJGbXed.
